assertions.evidence: The JSON request has "model": "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917", a "state" object with "review", and a "questions" object whose noul question has instructions and true/false criteria, and it is sent via curl to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions.

There is only one noul question, "is_toxic", whose true criterion bundles "targeted abuse, credible encouragement or threats of serious violence, or fraud/scam promotion" together instead of a separate noul per policy label.

The criteria ask whether the review "contains targeted abuse, credible encouragement or threats of serious violence, or fraud/scam promotion or solicitation", which is a semantic judgment and does not ask whether the words "idiot", "scam", or "kill" appear.
